newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra in alliance talks with BT - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra in alliance talks with BT - paper.

text.p: Australian government-owned telecommunications carrier Telstra Corp is believed to be in talks with British Telecommunications Plc (BT) in a bid to forge a global alliance, a newspaper report published on Tuesday said.
The Australian Financial Review newspaper said in an unsourced report that senior executives from both companies had met over the past six months to try and finalise arrangements.

"The alliance, if sealed, would give Telstra powerful leverage into the A$600 billion worldwide telecommunications market through one of the world's three biggest telecommunications companies," the newspaper said.
